title: PvE monster
description: This mode remove attack cooldown so you can spamming clicks like it was in old versions.
body:
This mod brings back the old combat system! There's no cooldown anymore so you can use all your PvE skills, show the true PvE monster living inside you! 
This lightweight mod removes attack cooldown and makes fighting system like it was in 1.8 Minecraft version. Neither weapon damage changes nor the way you use it.

 Multiplayer and Single Player Support

 -Single Player
Install on the client and play. No extra setup needed.

 -Multiplayer Servers
Install on the server only.
Clients do not need to install the mod.

  No configuration required. Have only forge version yet.
